summary: Reads the current vehicle name via VehicleNameAccessor using the module-manager global dword_7CD25C, validates it against the string table (byte_5EC4C0 / byte_5EC4CC), copies the validated name into the message buffer byte_5EC4CC, and drives the UI text update through UIStringComparison. If the name pointer is null or empty, falls back to displaying the default path string byte_5EA438. Returns 0 on both paths.

operations.description: Call VehicleNameAccessor(dword_7CD25C) to obtain the current vehicle name pointer from the game module manager.
Guard: if the returned pointer is non-null AND strlen(v0) is non-zero, take the vehicle-name path; otherwise take the fallback path.
Call BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, v0, byte_5EC4CC) to verify the vehicle name exists in the string table before use.
If the string-table search is truthy, copy the vehicle name v0 into the message buffer byte_5EC4CC via strcpy.
Call UIStringComparison(byte_5EC4CC) to update the UI text from the message buffer after the (possible) name copy.
Return 0 after updating the UI from the vehicle-name path.
On the fallback path, call UIStringComparison(byte_5EA438) to display the default path string.
Return 0 after updating the UI from the fallback path.
